Approved evidence

Alegion / SanctifAI data services

org.alegion

Prepared 10 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 10 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-10.prelaunch.1

Evidence & scope

Supplier inclusion audited from the pinned provider documents with separate source-verifier and adversarial AI reviews. Offerings, policy descriptions and provider-reported cases remain distinct from independently measured delivery, actual worker outcomes or commercial quality. Review of source statements does not establish ownership or operational certification. Alegion/SanctifAI is counted once; conflicting rebrand/division language remains explicitly scoped, with corporate-registry ownership unresolved.
